proposal.action: Impose a temporary 21-day movement restriction within the outbreak area, with essential-care/work exemptions, material support for affected households, seven-day independent review, and automatic expiry unless renewed on current evidence.
proposal.purpose: Reduce transmission of a highly contagious disease with a high fatality rate while a severe outbreak is active.
proposal.requested_authority: Temporarily restrict movement of people in the defined outbreak area.

evidence.claim: The disease is highly transmissible and has a high fatality rate in the affected population.
Current transmission is widespread enough that case-by-case isolation alone is not expected to interrupt transmission in time.
Strong epidemiological evidence indicates that a temporary reduction in close contact and movement would materially reduce transmission during the current outbreak.
Less restrictive measures including voluntary distancing, public advice and targeted isolation have already been used and have not reduced transmission sufficiently.
Movement restrictions create foreseeable harms including lost income, interrupted education, isolation, reduced access to ordinary services and possible unequal burdens on low-income households.
Food, income, medicine, emergency-care and essential-work support can be provided during the restriction period.
Transmission indicators can be reviewed at least weekly and the restriction can be narrowed or ended rapidly if the justification weakens.

affected_parties.party: People at high risk of severe disease or death
affected_parties.interests_or_risks: Protection from infection and continued access to care.
Liberty, income, education, social connection, privacy and access to essentials.
Disproportionate economic and practical burden if support is inadequate.
Duty to control the outbreak while avoiding unnecessary coercion.
Hospital capacity, transmission spillover and continuity of essential services.

alternatives.description: Continue voluntary distancing and advice without compulsory movement restrictions.
Use targeted isolation only for identified cases and contacts.
Use the proposed temporary area restriction with support, exemptions, independent review and automatic expiry.
Apply an indefinite or open-ended movement restriction until authorities declare the outbreak over.

uncertainties: The exact number of infections and deaths that the proposed restriction would prevent.
Whether all parts of the outbreak area require identical restrictions throughout the full 21 days.
How fully the support measures will offset economic and social burdens.
declared_conflicts_of_interest: The authority imposing restrictions also interprets some of the evidence supporting continuation, making independent review important.
requested_capability: Temporarily restrict movement during a severe contagious outbreak, subject to support, exceptions, weekly independent review and expiry.
